titulo: Renew your residence permit (including the Real Decreto 316/2026 permit)
resumen: Your temporary residence permit (autorización de residencia temporal) has an end date. To stay in Spain legally, you apply for renewal (or a change to another permit) in the 2 months before it expires or, at the latest, in the 3 months after. You pay the immigration fee (modelo 790 código 052, the official payment form) and, once the permit is granted, the fee for the TIE card (modelo 790 código 012). If you apply on time, your permit stays valid while you wait for the answer. If you have the permit from the 2026 extraordinary regularisation, it is not renewed in the same way: after one year you must change (modify) it to another permit.
paraQuien: For people from outside the European Union with a temporary residence permit (work, non-lucrative, family reunification, arraigo, exceptional circumstances) and for people who got the one-year permit from the extraordinary regularisation of Real Decreto 316/2026. It does not apply to long-term residence, to family members of EU citizens or to students (a study stay has its own extension).

Modelo 790 código 052: about 16,40 € for renewal of temporary residence and work (check the form)
Modelo 790 código 012: 19,30 € for renewal (check the current amount)
3 months; if they do not answer, renewals are usually treated as granted (silencio positivo, 'positive silence')
Usually 4 years, unless you qualify for long-term residence
Online on the official e-office (Mercurio) or at the Oficina de Extranjería (immigration office)
1-year permit: when it expires, you modify it to another permit; an extension is only an exception

pasos.titulo: Check the expiry date of your card and your permit
pasos.texto: The date is on your TIE (Tarjeta de Identidad de Extranjero, your foreigner ID card) and on the decision (resolución) that granted your permit. Write down the exact day. You can apply from 2 months before that date. If you miss it, you can still apply in the next 3 months, but you may get a fine (sanción).

pasos.titulo: Find out which type of permit you have
pasos.texto: Each permit has its own information sheet (hoja informativa) on the website of the Ministerio de Inclusión (Ministry of Inclusion). For example: Hoja 13 for residence and work as an employee, Hoja 7 for non-lucrative residence, Hoja 10 for family reunification. The sheet gives the exact requirements and the form (for example, EX-03 for work as an employee). If your permit comes from the 2026 extraordinary regularisation, see step 3.

pasos.titulo: If you have the 2026 regularisation permit, prepare the modification
pasos.texto: According to the official questions and answers of the Ministerio de Inclusión, the 1-year permit of Real Decreto 316/2026 is not renewed like the others. When it expires, you must apply for a modification to another permit in the Reglamento (article 191 of Real Decreto 1155/2024), for example residence and work. The deadline is the same: 2 months before or 3 months after expiry. The one-year permits granted in 2026 expire mostly between April and June 2027, so prepare early.

pasos.titulo: Know about the exceptional extension of the regularisation
pasos.texto: Only if you cannot apply for any modification, a 1-year extension (prórroga) is possible. For this, you must be actively looking for work and registered with the public employment service, or have a favourable integration effort report (informe de esfuerzo de integración) from your autonomous community. Some analyses of the Real Decreto mention a longer extension if a justified reason (illness, disability, retirement age) stops you from working: check the details in the BOE (Spain's official gazette) and on the official regularisation portal. Children who received a 5-year permit do not have to do this after one year.

Usually you need the signed application form, a full copy of your valid passport and the documents that prove you still meet the requirements (work, social security contributions, financial means, your children's school enrolment, etc.). Documents from other countries must be translated into Spanish. If something is missing, the office will ask you to provide it (requerimiento) and the time limit for an answer stops.

Create the form on the e-office of the Administraciones Públicas (the fees page, pasarela de tasas) and choose the renewal section (epígrafe) for your type of permit. According to the tables published for 2026, renewal of temporary residence and work costs about 16,40 €. The exact amount is the one shown when you create the form. Keep the proof of payment and attach it to your application.

You can do it online on the Mercurio platform of the e-office (you need a digital certificate, Cl@ve or a representative) or at the registry of the Oficina de Extranjería in your province. Keep the proof of submission (resguardo) with the date: it is your proof that you applied on time.

pasos.titulo: Wait for the decision with your resguardo
pasos.texto: If you apply on time, your old permit stays valid until they answer. Always carry your TIE (even if it has expired) together with the resguardo of your application. The Administration has 3 months to decide. For renewals, if they do not answer, the application is usually treated as granted (silencio positivo), but check in the information sheet of your permit if this applies to you.

pasos.titulo: Apply for the new card (TIE) and give your fingerprints
pasos.texto: When you are notified that it is granted, you have 1 month to apply in person for the new TIE at the police station (comisaría de Policía) or immigration office for your address. Book the official appointment (cita previa) on the Administraciones Públicas cita previa website (option 'Policía - toma de huellas', fingerprinting). Bring your passport, the decision, a recent photo and the proof of payment of the 790 código 012 fee. Later you go back to collect the card.

plazos.texto: General renewal: apply in the 2 months (60 days) before expiry or in the 3 months (90 days) after. If you apply after expiry, you may be fined.
If you apply on time, your old permit stays valid until they answer.

The Administration has 3 months to decide on the renewal. For renewals of residence and work, non-lucrative residence and family reunification, silence is positive (no answer means granted), according to the Ministry's information sheets.

2026 regularisation (RD 316/2026): the permit lasts 1 year. The modification to another permit is requested in the 2 months before or the 3 months after expiry. Applications were submitted from April to 30 June 2026 (1.174.978 applications), so many expire between April and June 2027.
After the permit is granted, you have 1 month from the notification to apply in person for the new TIE.
Renewal is usually granted for 4 years, unless you qualify for a long-term permit (usually after 5 years of legal and continuous residence).

errores: Waiting until your card expires to start. You can apply from 2 months before: do it early, especially if your permit expires between April and June 2027, when there will be many applications from the regularisation.
Thinking the 2026 regularisation permit renews by itself. It does not: after one year you must apply for a modification to another permit, or for the exceptional extension if you cannot modify it.
Applying for renewal more than 3 months after expiry. After that deadline it is no longer a renewal and you may end up without legal status.
Losing the resguardo of your application. It is your proof that you applied on time; keep it on paper and on your phone and carry it with your TIE.
Paying the fee with the wrong section (epígrafe). Check that the 790 código 052 form says 'renovación' (renewal) or 'modificación' (modification) for the correct type of permit.
Forgetting to apply for the new TIE in the month after the permit is granted. Without the card you will have problems working, travelling or doing other procedures.
Not translating foreign documents into Spanish. The office will ask you to fix it and your file will be delayed.

recordatorio.pregunta: When does your card (TIE) or your residence permit expire?

avisos.texto: Your permit expires in 3 months. Check which type you have, read its information sheet and start collecting documents. If it is from the 2026 regularisation, think about which permit you will modify it to.
From today you can submit the renewal or the modification. Pay the 790 código 052 fee and submit the application.
1 month left until expiry. If you have not submitted the application yet, do it now and keep the resguardo.
Your permit expires today. If you already applied for renewal, it stays valid with the resguardo. If not, you still have 3 months, but you may be fined: apply as soon as possible.
2 months have passed since expiry. If you have not submitted anything, you only have 1 month left. If you already submitted it, check the status of your file on the e-office.

variantes.texto: The 1-year permit is modified to another permit when it expires (article 191 of the Reglamento). Exceptional 1-year extension only if you cannot modify it, with active job search and registration with the public employment service, or with an integration effort report. Children who received a 5-year permit do not do this after one year. The Ministerio de Inclusión will publish more details on its regularisation portal: check there before you apply.
You must keep showing enough financial means and health insurance. See Hoja 7 of the Ministerio de Inclusión.
Renewal depends on the person who brought you (your sponsor) keeping their permit. See Hoja 10 of the Ministerio de Inclusión.

variantes.titulo: NIE or TIE? They are not the same
variantes.texto: The NIE is a number (a letter, seven digits and a letter) that identifies you with the Spanish administration for life; it never expires and, on its own, does not prove you hold a residence permit. The TIE is the physical card with your photo and your NIE that proves your residence authorisation and does expire: that is what you renew. In this procedure you renew the authorisation and then apply for the new TIE with fee 790-012; your NIE number never changes.
